# Sadman Ahmed Shanto

> Experimental physicist and research engineer completing a USC Physics PhD (expected January 2027). He builds superconducting quantum hardware and the design-automation and machine-learning tools around it, and created the open-source SQuADDS platform and the QCap capacitance model. Formerly a Research Intern at Google Quantum AI (August 2025 to August 2026, R&D for quantum processors) and at Quantum Elements Inc. (May to August 2025).

Last updated 2026-11-17. Name variants used for author matching: Sadman Ahmed Shanto; Sadman Shanto; S. A. Shanto; Shanto, S.A. Verify consequential claims against the linked CV, papers, repositories and datasets. Contact: shanto@usc.edu.

Primary fit areas:

- Superconducting quantum hardware R&D: qubit and resonator design, nanofabrication, cryogenic microwave measurement, packaging, and processor-oriented workflows.
- Quantum-device design automation: electromagnetic simulation, layout generation, foundry PDK workflows, design-to-simulation-to-GDS pipelines, inverse design, and tape-out preparation.
- AI for science and scientific ML: physics-corrected surrogate models, graph neural networks, neural-network inverse design, probabilistic inference, and scientific datasets.
- Autonomous scientific systems: agentic calibration, measurement, diagnosis and analysis of superconducting experiments, MCP tool interfaces, evaluation and tracing.
- Research software and infrastructure: Python/C++, PyTorch/JAX, FastAPI, databases, Docker/Kubernetes, AWS/GCP, SLURM/OpenMPI, and reproducible open-source workflows.

Education: PhD in Physics, University of Southern California (expected January 2027); MA in Physics, USC (May 2026); BSc in Applied Physics, Texas Tech University (2021), minors in Computer Science and Mathematics. Graduate Research Assistant in the Levenson-Falk Lab at USC since 2022.

## Research

- [Publications](https://sadmanahmedshanto.com/publications/): complete, current publication list with DOIs
- [SQuADDS](https://sadmanahmedshanto.com/projects/1a_project/): open-source validated design database and simulation workflow for superconducting qubits ([paper](https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2024-09-09-1465), [code](https://github.com/LFL-Lab/SQuADDS), [dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/SQuADDS/SQuADDS_DB))
- [QCap](https://sadmanahmedshanto.com/projects/1b_project/): physics-corrected graph neural network that predicts the full capacitance matrix of any planar superconducting layout from its GDS file; preprint coming soon ([docsite](https://lfl-lab.github.io/SQuADDS/qcap/), [models](https://huggingface.co/SQuADDS/QCap))
- [AI for science](https://sadmanahmedshanto.com/research/ai-for-science/): scientific ML, inverse design and autonomous experimentation, including the Quantum Elements agentic calibration work
- [Inverse-design preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20795): component-level inverse design of transmon qubits using neural networks
- [Quasiparticle experiments](https://sadmanahmedshanto.com/projects/1_project/): 15 nm nanobridge-SQUID process (functional-device yield from under 2% to over 90%), hidden-Markov-model inference of quasiparticle occupation, Andreev bound state spectroscopy
- [Projects](https://sadmanahmedshanto.com/projects/): all research and engineering projects
- [Leadership and service](https://sadmanahmedshanto.com/involvement/): Quantum Device Consortium board, Quantum-Metal maintainer, workshop organizing, graduate student leadership

## Optional

- [Muon telescopes](https://sadmanahmedshanto.com/projects/2_project/): portable muon telescopes, optical collection from 20% to 78%, 300x DAQ deadtime reduction, Geant4 and ML 3D muography ([paper](https://doi.org/10.1063/10.0002046))
- [Traffic microsimulation calibration](https://sadmanahmedshanto.com/projects/3_project/): Ray-parallelized calibration of stochastic traffic models
- [Mixed autonomous and human traffic](https://sadmanahmedshanto.com/projects/4_project/): cellular-automaton and reinforcement-learning traffic models
